evals.name: next-up-top5
evals.prompt: Check the tasker YouTrack board and tell me what I should work on next, top 5 by priority. DRY RUN: don't create Panes, worktrees or branches and don't change YouTrack; assume I pick #1 and show me exactly what you'd run to start it.
evals.expected_output: A ranked table from the live board (features first), notes on stale/blocked items (ts-12 looks done and blocks ts-13), and the exact runpane panes create command + implement-feature prompt for rank 1 (ts-10).
assertions: Ranks ts-10 (agent-sessions) as #1
Does not offer blocked features (ts-11, ts-13, ts-14, ts-15, ts-16) as startable
Flags ts-12 as done but still open on the board
Gives a runpane panes create command with --branch feature/ts-10-agent-sessions
The Pane agent's prompt invokes /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 (the installed command name)
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: start-ts10-medium
evals.prompt: Start ts-10 in Pane with implement-feature at medium depth. DRY RUN: don't create anything or touch YouTrack, just print the commands and the full prompt you'd send.
evals.expected_output: Confirms ts-10 is ready, a runpane panes create command with --branch feature/ts-10-agent-sessions and --name agent-sessions, and a prompt starting with /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium --stop-at-gates that tells the agent it already runs in the ticket's own Pane and worktree.
assertions: runpane command uses --branch feature/ts-10-agent-sessions and --name agent-sessions
Prompt starts with /yi-sdlc:implement-feature ts-10 medium
Prompt tells the agent it already runs in the ticket's own Pane and worktree
Plans to copy the git-ignored .claude/sdlc.local.md into the worktree
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: blocked-ts13
evals.prompt: Kick off ts-13 (the yi-sdlc flow panel) in its own Pane. DRY RUN: don't create anything or change the board.
evals.expected_output: Declines to start ts-13 because ts-10 is open; notes ts-12 is open on the board but looks done (all subtasks resolved), and suggests what to start instead.
assertions: Does not start (or green-light starting) ts-13
Names ts-10 as an open blocker of ts-13
Identifies ts-12 as done but still open on the board
Suggests starting ts-10 instead (or as the unblocking step)
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: pane-not-running
evals.prompt: Pane isn't open right now (I closed it). What's next on the tasker board? DRY RUN: don't create anything or change the board.
evals.expected_output: board.py launches the installed Pane app and waits for it; the report says Pane was started, ranks from the live Pane state (details-panel's Pane is found, so ts-12 is not treated as fresh), lists existing Panes' agent tabs as stopped and offers runpane panels resume without running it.
assertions: Runs board.py without --no-start-pane, so Pane is launched
Says in the report that Pane was started by this run
Ranking reflects existing Panes (no warning that Pane state is missing)
Lists the existing Panes' agents as stopped and offers to resume them without resuming any
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: named-ticket-still-confirms
evals.prompt: Start ts-10 in Pane. Answer Cancel to any confirmation question.
evals.expected_output: Confirms ts-10 is ready, then asks one confirmation question naming the count (1 ticket), ts-10 and how it starts (new Pane agent-sessions, implement-feature medium); on Cancel it stops with nothing created.
assertions: Asks a confirmation question before creating anything, although the arguments named ts-10
The question states the count and how ts-10 starts (new Pane agent-sessions, implement-feature medium)
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket

evals.name: auto-picks-top
evals.expected_output: No pick or confirmation question; takes the top 2 non-colliding candidates in rank order (ts-10 first), prints one 'Starting 2 tickets: ...' line, then the exact commands and prompts; offers the ts-12 board move without making it.
assertions: Asks no pick or confirmation question
Picks at most 2 candidates, in rank order, with ts-10 first
Prints a line with the count and the picks before the commands
Does not move ts-12 on the board (a board move still needs the operator)
Created no Pane, branch or worktree and changed no ticket
